summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of the reorganised CloudIVR landing (/cloudivr): the 3 product families, the grouped Products mega menu and mobile menu, the #esim section and the on-page eSIM checkout. Tested at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Everything requested passed. Families: the calling, texting and mobile cards are present. The calling CTA scrolls to #pricing. The texting CTA links to /cloudivr/signup?plan=texting. The mobile CTA opens the checkout. The 'more' links go to #features-ivr, #features-hosted and #esim. The old pillars, channel-slider and product-cards-section are all gone. Mega menu groups: calling has 7 items, texting has Landline to Texting, mobile has CloudIVR eSIM, and that item scrolls to #esim. The mobile menu lists the eSIM item and it scrolls there too. The esim-section shows the T-Mobile copy, 3 points and the SPENZA_001 card ($100 / 30 days, 'T-Mobile network'). Checkout validation: Next is disabled for 14 digits and for a 3-digit ZIP, and enabled for 15 digits with an empty ZIP or a 5-digit ZIP. Escape and the close button both close the checkout. Logged-out flow: 'Your account' step → wrong password shows 'Wrong email or password.' → signed up qa.esimco1793566138@example.com → 'Pay' step with esim-co-need '$0.00… Add $100', 8 coins → deposit shows the preview warning and the PREVIEW-MODE address. Alice: Continue went straight to Pay, with no account step. The draft prefilled /app/esim with IMEI 356938035643809 and ZIP 10011. Pay $100 from wallet → done → esim-co-open went to /cloudivr/app/esim. The new line es_5a56951918b2 showed 'Creating your eSIM…' and turned Active, then was cancelled through the confirm dialog and removed. es_69fcb8db0c34 was untouched. Spanish: families, esim section, menu groups, checkout steps and the error are all translated. Public /api/cloudivr-web/public/esim-plans returns carrier 'T-Mobile network' and price 100. /esim needs sign-in (not_signed_in), as expected. At 390px the families stack in one column, there is no horizontal scroll, and the checkout fits (366px wide, account step 620px tall).

ui_bugs.issue: maxLength=5 is applied before non-digits are stripped, so pasting '10a011' gives '1001', which silently blocks Continue

integration_issues.issue: The civr.esimDraft draft is only removed after a successful buy. Pressing Cancel on the buy form (esim-buy-cancel) keeps it, so every later visit to /app/esim reopens the buy form. The draft is also not tied to a user, so a different account in the same browser gets the same prefill.
useApi('/wallet') has no error branch. If /wallet fails, the Pay step spins forever.

issues: With only one plan, the card sits alone in a 3-column grid and leaves a big empty area to the right
The subtitle 'Seven ways people run their phone line on CloudIVR…' is missing from es.json and shows in English (outside this change, but visible next to the translated sections)

action_items: Clear (or ignore) civr.esimDraft when the user cancels the /app/esim buy form, and consider storing it with the account id
Strip non-digits before limiting the checkout ZIP length (remove maxLength or slice after replace)
Add an error state for the /wallet fetch in the checkout Pay step
Optional: centre or widen the eSIM plan grid when there is a single plan; translate the UseCases subtitle in es/fr
critical_code_review_comments: EsimCheckout Pay: the crypto auto-order only runs while the modal stays open (polling in the component). If the visitor closes it after paying, the wallet is funded but no order is placed. The /app/esim draft prefill partly covers this; consider an explicit notice.
EsimCheckoutHost: if the plans fetch fails or comes back empty, the Buy eSIM / family-mobile-cta buttons silently do nothing

success_rate.backend: skipped (frontend only; 1 public API checked via curl)
